packageRules.description: Internal stSoftwareAU/* packages are trusted and may update immediately (issue #17).
Apply the 24-hour quarantine explicitly to the github-actions manager so a freshly-pushed tag/SHA cannot land instantly (issue #17).

customManagers.description: Quarantine Deno standard library URL imports (e.g. https://deno.land/std@0.208.0/path/mod.ts) — these are picked up from any .ts file by matching the URL pattern (issue #17).

Quarantine CDN-loaded browser libraries (Bootstrap, Chart.js, chart.js-date-fns adapter) referenced from docs/index.html and docs/sw.js. Without this, CDN URLs escape Renovate's built-in managers and avoid the quarantine (issue #17).
